_comment: Tesla Tools Suite Configuration - Copy this file to 'config.json' or 'Tessie/config.json' and customize your local paths. archive_directory is optional (null by default) - when omitted or null, archives automatically default to an 'archive' subfolder inside your tessie_directory or target JSON directory. If external_drive_path is null/omitted, drives matching /Volumes/TESLADRIVE* are auto-discovered. evnex_username/evnex_password are your normal Evnex app login (email + password) for the community-maintained `evnex` python library (https://github.com/hardbyte/python-evnex), which talks to Evnex's own consumer app API - Evnex only issues real API keys to Enterprise/CP-Link customers. Prefer the EVNEX_CLIENT_USERNAME/EVNEX_CLIENT_PASSWORD env vars over config.json if you'd rather not keep the password on disk at all. pvoutput_api_key/pvoutput_system_id are placeholders for the PVOutput.org API (see Tessie/PVOUTPUT_API.md) - not yet wired up to any script, no real credentials requested yet. power_provider selects the active Tools/providers_power/ implementation (get_power_provider(), default 'agl' if omitted). power_usage_staleness_days (REQ-071) is the age, in days, at which power_usage_sync.py's post-consolidate reminder starts nagging for a fresh usage-export CSV from a manual-sync provider like AGL (default 14 if omitted) - purely a reminder, never blocks anything.
